name: Iset, Throne-Magic Mother
loreTies: Iset embodies throne magic, river restoration, protective motherhood, and sacred names within The Solar Dominion of Khepra.
The Sun-Scale Gate allows this deity to enter Ascension-era dungeon routes without collapsing the individuality of other Realms.
Aten Ra culture, symbols, weapons, and divine law shape every ability, artifact, silhouette, and combat choice.
shortBackstory: Iset, Throne-Magic Mother, is a playable goddess in Mythos Gates: Ascension. Iset is the true source-realm divinity behind the mythology — throne magic, river restoration, protective motherhood, and sacred names. Ascension expands divine power during the current Gate crisis; it does not turn a mortal into a god.

chapters.title: Divine Origin
chapters.text: Iset is not a mortal hero inspired by myth. Iset is the actual goddess recognized by Aten Ra source culture, born from the supernatural laws of The Solar Dominion of Khepra. Their domain — throne magic, river restoration, protective motherhood, and sacred names — determines their symbols, weapons, posture, combat instincts, and relationship to sacred authority.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Within Aten Ra, Iset expresses the civilization rather than merely representing it. Their visual identity must carry the materials, beauty standards, divine symbols, and sacred rules of The Solar Dominion of Khepra. Their gameplay role, Sustain, must grow from mythology first and mechanics second.

chapters.title: Mythos Gate Wound
chapters.text: During the Ascension era, Iset can interact with The Sun-Scale Gate because divine beings are intrinsically connected to their Realms. The Gate does not become a simple teleportation portal; it is a mysterious boundary where separate mythological realities become traversable. Iset understands some rites of crossing, but not the complete origin of the Mythos Gates.

chapters.title: Dungeon Role
chapters.text: When selected by the player, Iset enters the dungeon alone as one god or goddess against multiple enemies. No army follows. No squad shares control. Every room, trap, shrine, relic, elite, and boss encounter must test how throne magic, river restoration, protective motherhood, and sacred names survives pressure from creatures, rival Realm laws, and unstable Gate conditions.

chapters.title: Ascension Conflict
chapters.text: Ascension is the current story arc, not the permanent end-state of the Mythos Gates universe. For Iset, Ascension means restoration, awakening, evolution, or expansion of existing divine power. Their personal conflict is to recover strength without reducing Aten Ra mythology into raw fuel for the crisis.

relationshipHooks: Faction witnesses interpret how Iset crosses The Sun-Scale Gate.
Rival deities challenge the limits of cross-Realm travel.
Dungeon lore pickups reveal Gate mystery without resolving the full origin.
developmentStatus: Playable deity backstory aligned to Mythos Gates identity, one-deity dungeon runs, current Ascension arc, and preserved Lore Codex canon.
mythicSource: Isis/Iset + throne magic + restoration + river afterlife passage
visualCanon: Sustain deity with a throne-silhouette crown, lotus and papyrus river mantle, blue faience and river-glass channels, soft gold sun-disc between protective horn-like arcs, linen-light veils, and restorative hand-ray patterns. Must feel protective and sovereign, not a goddess cosplay or generic healer.
title: Throne-Magic Mother

mythosGatesCanon.identityRule: Iset is the actual goddess of Aten Ra source mythology, never a mortal hero or generic champion.
mythosGatesCanon.arcRule: Ascension restores, awakens, evolves, or expands existing divine power; it does not make the character a god for the first time.
mythosGatesCanon.mysteryRule: The backstory may reveal how this deity interacts with the Mythos Gates, but must not resolve the full origin of the Gates.
